data.body:
Completion-evidence classification repair after the verifier's external-receipt finding.

The two independent-review/TSV acceptance criteria are now explicitly tagged [non-codebase], because the reviewer attestation and its row ledger are tracker artifacts rather than repository files.

Concrete attestation:
- Reviewed source commit: 929425bd313448c54a08ec998c5e473690bfd5e9 against immutable parent 360d504f5ceb2e80148084bf6aa5a20589984200.
- Exact receipt: 56 TSV data rows under the canonical schema stable_block_id, before_citation, final_citation, preserved_contract_or_consumer, directives_exact, before_words, final_words, reviewer_session, semantic_preservation, bloat_removal.
- Canonical artifact: session log vapourific-voracious-nerka, comment headed "Receipt mirror from supplemental session log kooky-warty-tern".
- Supplemental artifact: kooky-warty-tern (0bec-70c6-f8c2-4825).
- Reviewer session on every row: /root:couped-parttime-nag-independent-review; the reviewer states they did not author the patch.
- Receipt totals: 5,470 before-words -> 2,090 final-words; all 56 rows strictly shrink and record directives_exact=PASS, semantic_preservation=PASS, and bloat_removal=PASS.
- Three-stage verdict: APPROVED, required changes 0, blocking findings 0.
- Gerrit evidence: change 2804 reached LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1; revision 8549294cf84759f6fc00d8639cef0643e4569c84 merged at 2026-09-07T23:23:36Z.

The repository-verifiable criteria remain untagged and continue to be checked against the merged tree.
